summary: Baseline design audit completed for NeXify IdentityHero component across 5 viewport sizes (1920x800, 1440x900, 2560x1440, 3840x2160, 390x844). Measured DOM geometry, computed styles, background gradients, text/video overlaps, panel dimensions, and video control behavior. Spot-checked 4 routes for shell consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Text/video overlap detected in desktop viewports (1920x800, 1440x900, 2560x1440, 3840x2160). Both .identity-copy and .identity-video span the full container width (0 to 1320px at 1920x800), violating the strict 2-column layout requirement.
ui_bugs.root_cause: CSS layout uses absolute positioning for .identity-stage and .identity-video, causing them to overlay the text column instead of forming separate grid columns
ui_bugs.design_guideline_violation: Strict 2-column Hero without overlay: text left, video right (design_guidelines.md line 164)

ui_bugs.issue: Video time resets to ~0s when mute button is toggled. User loses playback position.
ui_bugs.root_cause: Video element remounts on mute toggle due to key={soundOn?'on':'off'} in IdentityHero.tsx line 74. This forces React to destroy and recreate the video element.
ui_bugs.user_impact: Users cannot unmute video without losing their place

ui_bugs.issue: 7 background gradients detected. User reported 'background divided into four parts with large areas' - multiple gradients can show visible seams on large displays.
ui_bugs.note: Visual inspection needed to confirm seams. CSS shows 7 radial-gradient layers in .identity-scene background.

ui_bugs.issue: Panel width is 600px on desktop, exceeding design guideline maximum of 440px

design_issues.issue: Current implementation uses absolute positioning for video, creating overlay instead of true 2-column grid. Design guidelines require 'strict 2-column layout (text left, video right) without overlay'.
design_issues.expected_implementation: grid-template-columns with separate text and video columns, no absolute positioning

design_issues.issue: Video remounts on mute toggle, breaking playback continuity
design_issues.expected_implementation: Control muted attribute without remounting video element

design_issues.issue: 7 gradient layers may show seams on large displays. User feedback: 'background divided into four parts'
design_issues.note: Requires visual inspection at 2560x1440 and 3840x2160 to confirm seams

passed_tests: Page loads successfully at all viewport sizes
Mobile layout (390x844) has no text/video overlap - proper stacking
Video element exists with correct attributes (autoplay, muted, loop, playsInline)
Video controls (play/pause, mute) are present and clickable
Shell components (header, main, panel) present and visible on all pages
Video object-fit: contain preserves aspect ratio
Video object-position: 70% bottom on desktop, 50% bottom on mobile

priority_1_critical: Fix text/video overlap: Refactor IdentityHero layout from absolute positioning to true CSS Grid 2-column layout. Text column left, video column right, no overlay. Reference design_guidelines.md lines 164-186.

Fix video time reset: Remove key={soundOn?'on':'off'} from video element (IdentityHero.tsx line 74). Control muted attribute directly without remounting. Use useEffect to toggle video.muted property instead.
priority_2_medium: Reduce panel max-width to 440px per design guidelines (currently 600px). Update WorkspaceRebuild.css line 2.

Review background gradients: 7 layers detected. User reports 'background divided into four parts'. Consider simplifying gradient stack or adjusting radial-gradient positions to eliminate seams on large displays.
priority_3_observations: Mobile layout (390x844) works correctly with proper stacking - use as reference for desktop 2-column implementation.
All routes and shell components working correctly - no structural issues found.
Typography scaling works well across viewports.
Video controls are functional and accessible with data-testid attributes.

success_percentage.frontend: 60% - Core functionality works, but critical layout and UX issues present
success_percentage.layout_compliance: 20% - Desktop viewports fail 2-column requirement (4/5 viewports have overlap)
success_percentage.video_controls: 50% - Controls present and clickable, but time reset breaks UX
success_percentage.route_consistency: 100% - All routes load with correct shell structure

notes: This is a BASELINE audit - no code changes made, only measurements and reporting
Screenshots captured at 1920x800 and 390x844 for visual reference
User feedback addressed: 'background divided into four parts' - 7 gradients detected
User feedback addressed: 'not so completely distorted' - video uses object-fit: contain
All measurements follow 8px grid system verification
Video time reset is reproducible and critical for UX
